hellaswag.selection: 1000 without replacement, Python Random(20261019), before inference

protocol.metrics: Official lm-eval 0.4.8 acc / acc_norm; acc_norm uses choice character count
protocol.seeds: No cross-seed ensemble; mean and population standard deviation across independent seeds
protocol.baseline: Fresh matched cached BF16 only, never historical native Harness scores
protocol.pairing: Per seed and task, identical doc IDs; report correct→wrong / wrong→correct
protocol.attention: Actual 24-layer single-token scoring decode; original multi-token prefix Attention
protocol.short_context: Prompts/answers here are short; fixed eight 64-token blocks can retain all K. Inspect active_sampling_stats; this is not a long-context pruning test
protocol.partial: Unsealed progress shown separately with its n; never called a complete task or compared to full baseline
protocol.commit: execution_commit is frozen runtime SHA, not collector Git HEAD
